assertions.description: corroboration never fires in a scenario with no checkpoint (TC-82)

description: This scenario demonstrates how the network behaves when a training job ends, a phase that is often overlooked but can cause its own brief disruptions if not handled cleanly. When the job finishes, compute nodes stop sending traffic and wait for a confirmation signal before releasing their resources; the compute fabric quiets down in an orderly way, and no checkpoint verification is triggered because the job ended without a checkpoint save. The dashboard shows the traffic collapse and the clean end-of-job handshake completing normally. This matters because a disorderly job termination — where nodes stop at different times or fail to release resources — can interfere with the next job's startup and corrupt shared state, so confirming clean teardown behaviour is an important operational check.
